mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ledger_book (id, entity_type, entity_id, currency, chart_id, book_status, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{currency}, #{chartId}, #{bookStatus}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, entity_type, entity_id, currency, chart_id, book_status, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_ledger_book WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, entity_type, entity_id, currency, chart_id, book_status, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_ledger_book WHERE entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId} AND currency = #{currency}
SELECT b.id ledger_book_id, b.entity_type, b.entity_id, b.currency, b.chart_id, c.chart_code, b.book_status FROM t_ledger_book b JOIN t_chart_of_accounts c ON c.id = b.chart_id WHERE b.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_ledger_book WHERE chart_id = #{chartId}
SELECT id, entity_type, entity_id, currency, chart_id, book_status, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_ledger_book WHERE entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId} ORDER BY id
